notes: Encoded ONLY from HYFRA's own page. Page states year from the 1st & 2nd numerical digits; the serial is all digits, so no counting ambiguity arises. No month or week is stated in text, so this style ships year-only. Parent is Lennox per the page, but no shared-system claim is made (shared parent alone does not establish a shared serial system) and no usesStylesOf is set. No era dates are documented on the page, so the default yearFloor 1960 applies.

styles.notes: Page positions: 1st & 2nd numerical digits (normalized positions [0,2]) are the year. Page example 0410118 decodes to 2004.
